names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 1 aprilie, «Sfântul Cuvios Varsanufie de la Optina».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Βαρσανούφιος της Όπτινα», with the rank word and the monastery left off.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «Pavel Ivanovici Plihankov, fiul lui Ioan și Natalia Plihankov, s-a născut în orașul Samara în 5 iulie 1845».

death.note: doxologia.ro: «La începutul lui 1913, Sfântul Varsanufie s-a îmbolnăvit din nou… Sfântul s-a dus la cele sfinte în ziua de 1 aprilie».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 1 aprilie — «Sfântul Cuvios Varsanufie de la Optina»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Βαρσανούφιος της Όπτινα»

attestations.note: The life page, https://www.saint.gr/1807/saint.aspx, has its own «Ημερομηνία Εορτής» of 1 Απριλίου and «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή», and heads him «(1845 - 1913)». Its whole notice is two sentences: «Ο Όσιος Βαρσανούφιος γεννήθηκε στις 5 Ιουλίου 1845 μ.Χ. στη Ρωσία. Ασκήτεψε στην έρημο της Όπτινα και κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη το έτος 1913 μ.Χ.» The day of birth, 5 July 1845, and the year of repose, 1913, are exactly what this folder already records from doxologia.ro, so the dates are untouched; saint.gr adds nothing to them and gives neither his name in the world nor his monastic office, both of which the folder already has. It prints no hymn and no distich.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
